---
# The submission title page. It carries NO identity of its own: authors,
# thanks, funding, correspondence, and declarations arrive from _quarto.yml
# at render time, so the real block lives in one place.
#
#   quarto render title-page.qmd --to ssus-titlepage-pdf
#
# submit.sh renders it on the base config (or on TITLEPAGE_PROFILE, for a
# paper that keeps its identity in a profile), and its checklist warns when
# a name is missing from the page.
format: ssus-titlepage-pdf
---
